tools.name: LatencyMon
tools.summary: Measures DPC/ISR latency and names the driver responsible for spikes. Run it for 5+ minutes while idle and while gaming.

tools.name: CapFrameX
tools.summary: Frametime and 1%/0.1% low capture and comparison. Benchmark before and after changes — trust your own numbers over any guide.

tools.name: NVIDIA FrameView
tools.summary: Frametimes plus PC latency (with Reflex-enabled games) for NVIDIA GPUs.

tools.name: Bufferbloat test
tools.summary: Shows how much your ping rises under load. Grade B or worse: enable SQM/Smart Queue on your router.

tools.name: NVIDIA Profile Inspector
tools.summary: Edits driver settings NVIDIA Control Panel hides. "Import Falcon profile" loads Falcon's competitive base profile: low-latency mode, highest refresh rate, unlimited shader cache, prefer max performance, V-Sync forced off (G-SYNC users: set V-Sync On in NVIDIA Control Panel afterwards).

tools.name: Display Driver Uninstaller
tools.summary: Fully removes GPU drivers for a clean install. Run in Safe Mode when switching GPU brands or fixing driver problems.

tools.name: NVCleanstall
tools.summary: Installs NVIDIA drivers without telemetry and bundled extras you do not want.

tools.name: MSI Mode Utility v3
tools.summary: Shows interrupt mode and priority for every device. Falcon already handles the GPU; use this for advanced per-device tuning.

tools.name: hidusbf (USB polling rate)
tools.summary: Overclocks the USB polling rate of controllers (e.g. DualShock 4 / DualSense to 1000 Hz). Bundled — read the included README before installing the driver.

tools.name: Autoruns
tools.summary: Microsoft Sysinternals' complete view of everything that starts with Windows. The right way to trim startup apps.

tools.name: FanControl
tools.summary: Custom fan curves from any temperature sensor. Keeps boost clocks up by keeping temps down.
